title: AI Portal
subtitle: List published agents for employees; they only see the name, description and category — never the type of the underlying resource.
actionFailed: The action failed. Please try again.
empty: No portal apps yet. Add a published agent, then list it for employees.
sourceHint: Only published, usable resources are listed; the source cannot be changed once listed.
sourceLocked: A listed app cannot change its source — delist it first.
noSources: Nothing to choose from: publish an agent first.
added: Added — employees see it once it is listed

confirm.listBody: Before listing we check that the source is published, the audience is valid and no capability reference is broken; employees see it right away.
confirm.delistBody: Employees stop seeing it and cannot start new calls at once; history follows the portal settings; configuration and audit records are kept.
confirm.deleteBody: The configuration disappears from the list; the action is audited.

settings.previewSoon: Preview opens once the employee side is live
